def max_rects(g, mind=3):
    g=np.array(g); h,w=g.shape; out=[]
    for i in range(h-mind+1):
        for j in range(w-mind+1):
            v=g[i,j]
            W=mind
            while j+W-1<w and (g[i,j:j+W]==v).all(): W+=1
            W-=1
            if W<mind: continue
            H=mind
            while i+H-1<h and (g[i:i+H,j:j+W]==v).all(): H+=1
            H-=1
            up = i>0 and (g[i-1,j:j+W]==v).all()
            lf = j>0 and (g[i:i+H,j-1]==v).all()
            if up or lf: continue
            out.append((int(v),i,j,H,W))
    return out
